description:
This six-hour tour will give you the chance to see Barcelona’s historical, architectural and gastronomical highlights. 

Starting at La Rambla, one of Barcelona’s busiest streets, you’ll see the famous La Boqueria market and examples of ornate Gothic architecture at Plaça Reial. You’ll also be able to explore the Gothic Quarter and watch street performers during a coffee break. 

You’ll learn about Gaudí’s life, art and architecture while walking around Park Güell and along the Passeig de Gràcia. After a tapas and wine lunch, you’ll round off the trip with a self-guided tour of the Sagrada Família.

offers.label: The most complete Full Day Private Tour, with Sagrada Familia and Park Guell!!!!

name: Barcelona Highlights and Gaudí Masterpieces Tour
shortDescription: A six-hour journey to the city's famous landmarks with two Gaudí attraction visits
additionalInfo:
Please bring your ticket with you to the attraction.

Be aware that operators may cancel for unforeseen reasons.

You need to be 18 years or older to book or be accompanied by an adult.
whatsIncluded: Skip-the-line admission to the Sagrada Família
covid: Hand sanitiser available for visitors and staff
Physical distancing measures enforced at all times
Regular temperature checks required for staff
Staff required to wash hands regularly

departure.instructions: Meet your guide at the Museu Arpi entrance.

ReviewDetails.content: Tour was thoughtfully planned and executed. We enjoyed our time with Raphael. We wished we had more time at Sagrada Familia  and would have liked for him to escort us inside and provide historical information. He did a great explaining the building from the outside.

Alan was absolutely amazing. The sweetest guy. He was incredibly knowledgeable about ALL things Spain especially Barcelona. He showed us ALL things about the city with the history and passion that made it so much fun. His suggestions, tips and just warm caring conversation were so unique and welcome. We had an incredibly full and fun day with him. I recommend him highly. I’ve been all over Europe with many tour guides. Alan was by far the best. Thank you so much for sharing him with us!

Having Milena be our tour guide was definitely the highlights of our trip!  She was accommodating with our family of 7 (seniors, adults, and children) and didn't mind taking breaks.  She's super knowledgable and we learned so much about the history of Spain and grew a better appreciation for the architecture.  Thank you Milena for your time and vibrant energy!

Spent a pleasant day with Adriana touring Barcelona.  We only had a couple days in the city and wanted to have a private tour to make the most of our time.  Adriana was knowledgeable and patient.  There was a nice pace to the tour and thankfully, the weather cooperated.  Highly recommend.
Pedro was an outstanding guide. He was very knowledgeable and personable. He went out of his way to make a memorable tour.
Louigi was a fantastic guide. He was very knowledgable about the sites, the area, art and history in general. He was clearly a seasoned expert :)
Our tour guide Paulo was the best ever!  I actually miss him!  He was so knowledgeable and made the tour so much fun. I highly recommend this wonderful experience!!  Great memories!

This 7 hour tour was a great way to see the highlights of Barcelona.   Our tour guide Vincenta was very friendly, knowledgeable, and wanted to ensure that we understood her.  This tour has a considerable amount of walking and guide was sensitive to our group's capabilities.  We did not realize that the tour would be rearranged to end at Park Guell versus La Familia Sagrada which required an additional taxi fare.  You may want to request that your guide end the tour with the site that you want to spend the most time at or ask what the plan is at the beginning of the tour.  For the guided tour at La Sagrada it is beneficial to take your own headphones for your phone to listen to the guided tour via the La Sagrada app which requires your ticket information. We also were not offered an option for Catalan wine/beer during our lunch and had coffee & chocolates at a location other than 4Gats which was very nice.  Overall a great tour experience!

Our guide was very engaging and interesting 
Overall it was an excellent experience 
I would recommend our guide to anyone interested in the culture of Barcelona 
I find having a compulsory minimum in this box very irritating and might well have abandoned the exercise

Alan was the best tour guide! He was friendly and very knowledgeable. He showed us the best local spots for coffee and tapas. We learned a lot about Gaudí and the history in Barcelona. I highly recommend Alan for all you Barcelona tours!!!
It worth the $, better off just getting the tickets and going to Park Guell and Sagrada Familia on your own.

Hernan was amazing! He was responsive to all the messages through the website or whatsapp. Very knowledgable and passionate . we visited Barcelona before but definitely this time we learned much more and fell more in love with it

Luigi was fantastic.  He had so much knowledge and really showed me a lot in one day.  I enjoyed what I saw, experienced Barcelona in a unique way and felt very comfortable with Luigi who took care of me for the day.  He was prompt, knowledgeable and friendly.  At the times I entered somewhere on my own, he was right there to get me when I came out.  Excellent guide!!  Barcelona was fantastic and I would love to return again some day.
Our guide was wonderful. She showed us the city of Barcelona and made sure we were safe when she left.

It really is a complete tour!  The description is accurate - the guide, Luigi, met us in a convenient area and we did a 3 hour walking tour of the city, stopping at some architectural sites where Gaudi contributed.  There was a coffee stop at a bar Picasso frequented.  After the walking tour we took a taxi and we had about an hour at Parc Guell on our own and then we took a taxi to the Sagrada Familia, where before entering we had a tapas lunch with choices picked out by Luigi (after checking our preferences).  Then he left us and we did the audioguide for the Sagrada Familia on our own.  Well planned and worth it if you only have a day in the city.
Our guide was well read, informative and very pleasant. Sorry I forgot his name. He made the trip more fun!

Jenny provided an excellent guided tour for my family in English. All the highlights were hit in a one day spectacular using all her local knowledge to avoid the tourist crush. Cannot recommend her services highly enough.

Paolo is a fantastic to guide. Since he used to teach philosophy, he explained the history, art and architecture of Barcelona to us in a fun and easy way. 

He organizes your trip in the most efficient way. We started in the Gothic area of Barcelona and saw the gems of architecture in the area. Then we took a taxi and saw Sagrada Familia with the audio guide from inside. He picked an excellent Spanish restaurant, which was Halal. Also next we went to Park Guell.

Paolo customize the tour to our needs. He made it interesting for our teenage children. He had interesting commentary regarding the independence movement in Catalan. Basically Tailored, the tour for our needs.

We highly recommend him especially for families.
Our guide was wonderful. Very knowledgeable. Really enjoyed our tour. I would definitely recommend this tour.

If you need to cover the most historical and important parts of Barcelona in a day then this would the tour to take. Our guide Meit was so good, she was moving slowly, matching everyone's pace. She pointed out all the history about the places we visited. Also you can have the local Spanish tapas here, which is included. Highly recommend this tour!

Milena was our tour guide. she met us on time at a prearranged address on La Rambla.  she had texted info and tickets the day before.  she was lovely, friendly and full of information about the history and area.  Milena was adaptable to our needs for the tour. when we sat to have lunch it was like sitting with an old friend

My wife and I had fantastic time during the tour. It was very well designed. It was mostly walking tour but with breaks for sightseeing or having lunch or coffee. We liked that it was active time but not rushed or exhausting. Adriana was wonderful guide. She was very knowledgable and answered all our curious questions. I would definitely recommend this trip because it covers all Barcelona's essential must see places.

Our guide was exceptionally knowledgeable about Goudi and the history of Spain.  We had a fantastic day touring the city, and Allen was very accommodating regarding the pace for my elderly parents.  Well worth the time.
Vincenta was so great!! She was very knowledgeable about her home town Barcelona! She was so sweet; we had the best time!

Our family really enjoyed this walking tour. Our guide PAOLO was super knowledgeable and eager to share so much of Spain’s history with us.  We walked a lot so definitely wear sneakers or comfortable walking shoes. The Sagrada Familia was a must see and simply unreal. The lunch was fantastic, more than enough, and easily adaptable for likes or dislikes. Unfortunately Park GUELL was closed due to a wind advisory. Our guide said that had never happened before, so we were super bummed about that especially since we paid and didn’t get to go in. (Hoping VIATOR will refund part of this excursion 🤞🏻) I’m still not certain why wind would prevent entry, it was breezy, but nothing crazy. But I would do this tour again if given the chance…it was well organized and a lot packed in.
I had an architect and historian all by myself for 6 hours. It's an expensive but very valuable experience.
Our guide, Jennifer, was awesome! She was great with our kids and getting us around the city and telling us the story of each stop. We all enjoyed our tour very much.
So much walking but so worth it! Gave us such a wonderful feel of Barcelona. Our guide was amazing and so knowledgeable.

Jennifer was our guide and she was wonderful!  She was very knowledgeable about
the area and highlighted the unique aspects of each place we visited.  I was having a lot of pain from recent hip surgery and Jennifer secured a wheelchair for me a even pushed me at Park Guell. Jennifer went above and beyond her duties as a guide and made sure that I was comfortable on the tour.

Adriana was a fabulous guide. She was so friendly and experienced. She made time for a couple of personal stops that we wanted to make. So appreciative. We loved all the information she gave us. The tapas lunch was delicious. We were completely happy with the whole day.

With had another tour guy from you company before, Jen our tour guide was above excellent.  You should hire her to teach and train your other tour guides. She was so good that she will be your competition in the 2-3 years.  Don’t loose her.  Tony@94truth.com
Adriana was amazing! She is definitely the one who makes me love Barcelona so much. Thank you for such being a great companion in this beautiful city.

Raphael was our tour guide for two 75 year old first time visitors to Barcelona. He reconstructed the tour to make it easier for us to get around and enjoy the experience. He was very patient and extremely knowledgeable with the area and the sights. If all your guides are as through and competent as Rapheal this tour will be an experience of a lifetime for whoever takes it.
Luigi was a great tour guide. Very friendly and knowledgeable. He explained in details history of many buildings and places across the city
Paulo was an excellent guide and provided a fun day. The sights and  lunch was great and will be memorable.

Pedro gave us a thorough, fun and information packed walking tour of Barcelona’s high points & significant architecture by Gaudi & his contemporaries. We had a beautiful time at Park Güell, and of course, the highlight of the day was immersing ourselves in the spectacular La Segrada. Truly, a work of his passion and artful soul.
Paolo did a great job! He was knowledgeable and easy to he around. We had a great lunch and loved everything he showed us!! Thank you for a great day!

We had an amazing day and enjoyed the full yet flexible itinerary.  A great price for everything that is included.  Highly recommend!

Most importantly, we had a wonderful guide, Bunella.  She was incredibly knowledgable and friendly.  Not only did she ensure we had a great day during our tour, but she also gave us excellent recommendations for food and local sights in the part of the city that we were planning to check out the next day.  Thank you!!
We had an excellent tour with Ivanna!  Everything was just perfect!  Would highly recommend Ivanna! Enjoyed the Tapas lunch and we walked over 14,000 steps on this tour!  We saw a lot!

Laura, our guide, was wonderful. She reached out to us while we were at home pre trip, and then again the day before our tour with updates. She was informative without overwhelming us with facts. Highly recommend Laura.

Our guide Dani was great; very friendly and knowledgeable. Learned a lot…
Barcelona is beautiful and Dani intrigued us with many interesting facts.

When Fred says this is the complete full day tour everything included…he isn’t kidding. It was wonderful, had coffee in Picasso’s favorite spot, had a wonderful lunch of traditional tapas, saw many interesting things and learned much from our amazing guide, Fred.  I would book him again and again. A “do not miss” kind of experience.  Loved it!
Excellent tour with a lot of walking but plenty of time to stop and sit if needed! Sebastian was excellent, great English!
Paulo was excellent as a tour guide. He wasn’t rushed and he told us stories and history of Barcelona in a complete way.

This was a fabulous tour!  We are so glad we did this as a private tour. We were able to see so much of Barcelona and learned about Gaudí and his influence on the architecture of Barcelona. The most important take away was that we need to look up at the buildings instead of just at eye level. 
And our guide Jenny could not have been better. We skipped Park Guell-it was closed. But the Sagrada Familia was very impressive.
The company canceled twice on us at the last minute. We were very disappointed. We were looking forward to the tour.
Daniel was a wonderful guide. Best tour we have ever had. We learned so much about Barcelona in the one day we had available.

We had 3 days in Barcelona. We booked for 4 people. The other couple had to cancel due to the hurricane. Viator would not allow only 2 people. Could not find another tour. Others were more expensive and less sites. We decided to keep the booking. Our tour guide informed us the night before she could not get tickets to Sagrada Familia. We were a bit disappointed. Vicenta was very nice and enjoyable guide. Wish we had been able to see Sagrada Familia.

Fred, our awesome tour guide, met us bright and early at the departure location.  He was extremely knowledgeable and easy to understand.  He was also patient with our group when we wanted to stop and look in a shop for a few minutes and he answered all of our questions!  He showed us all over Barcelona which is now one of my all time places to visit and cannot wait to go back!  He sat with us at the tapas restaurant.  and ordered food that was typical of the region.  It was delicious!! We loved seeing all of Guadi's work but we especially amazed at the Sagraada Familia.  It was stunning!!!!.  Thank you Fred for an awesome day!! I would HIGHLY recommend for all to take this tour!
Great way to see a lot of the city in one day.  Our guide was great. Very knowledgeable and was very clear on  expectations.
Jenny was the best host ever and very LGBTQ friendly.   Nothing we would have changed perfect in every way.

I've been to Barcelona twice before, but this time I really saw and experienced Spain.   If you come to Barcelona and don't take this tour, you haven't been to Spain.  Our guide, Dani, was, by far, the best tour guide I have ever had.  Come to Barcelona and experience Catalonian culture.  See how this area evolved over the last 2000 years and if at all possible, let Dani be your tour guide and allow him to bring Barcelona to life.
Ilona was very knowledgeable, gracious & charming. We enjoyed her company as much as her insight into the world of Gaudì.

Paolo was the perfect guide on a perfect Fall day in Barcelona. The day was an ideal balance of historical context and everyday life in Barcelona. We fell in love with the city and left as if we’d made a friend!

John, our tour guide, was amazing. He paved the tour extremely well, although the description did not clearly state how concentrated the walking would be at the beginning of the tour.  This would have been helpful since my husband has some mobility issues.

Park Guell
 need to go back but got a quick glimpse of the major attraction. A fast summary of what there is to see. Did not know about ticket options or need for EarPods in La FAM Sagrada

We were 4 seniors on a Viking cruise who booked Viator tour weeks before our cruise. I was connected to Viator guide and she mentioned that we needed to bring headphones and our cellphones. I told her we did not have cell phones that would handle ear buds. I contacted her several times looking for a concrete solution to our headphone problem but was told "not to worry". Guide did not have a concrete solution despite my reaching out to her. 48 hours before tour when I emailed her and said I was not comfortable with no concrete resolution and we were going to cancel the tour.  Her answer was   "if you have bluetooth headphones, bring those. Otherwise, I do 'believe' Sagrada familia keeps some audio devices on the side".  This was not tooo reassuring  for us and we were spending over $500 and had no concrete solution for our headphone issue.   I spoke with our Viking contact in Barcelona who was able book us on a tour with Viking.  We were in Barcelona for only 48 hours and, were so looking forward to the tour. We have used Viator for many years and NEVER had a problem.

Sharon was an excellent and knowledgeable tour guide. We took a private walking tour with a strong focus on the works of Antoni Gaudi - covered old town Barcelona, La Sagrada Familia and then ended at Park Güell. She arrived early, was flexible with our group to take photos or get souvenirs. She was even helpful after the tour recommending things for us to do in the evening. Highly recommend, Sharon!

The entire tour was memorable.  Our tour guide, Fred, showed us the Roman influence from the original walled city to La Rambla, to the Farmer’s Market (awesome) and Gaudi’s influence on the city with the private residences, Park Guell and of course, his masterpiece, Zola Sagrida Familia.   It was so awe inspiring.  Words cannot express the breathtaking exterior and interior of the life of Jesus Christ.  Fred was so knowledgeable and did so in a way that made it very easy to understand the old and new Barcelona and Gaudi’s influence and love of the city of Barcelona and what a genius he was.
Vicenta was an excellent tour guide and made us feel very comfortable exploring this marvelous city.    We highly recommend this tour with Vicenta.
Pedro was very knowledgeable and made the day enjoyable would definitely recommend this trip for anyone interested

Had the best time with Melanie! I felt like it was a girls day exploring the city. Her English was great she was so kind! I was nervous to explore on my own as my husband had to work and it was just perfect. She knew so much and I had a great time. Thank you for an experience I’ll never forget.

What can I say other than perfect!! Milena was exceptionally knowledgeable and the tour was incredibly personal and timely. As we walked through different parts of the city she not only shared her knowledge of Barcelona’s history but was open to answer questions about current events. I cannot say enough about how detailed Milena was during tour and offered great conversation throughout. Truly a 5 star experience! Also we stopped by a chocolate shop that I absolutely will be visiting before I travel back home, a perfect recommendation to the fantastic tour.
Enjoyed every moment of this tour. Daniel our guide was absolutely brilliant with knowledge and kindness. He told us things we would simply never known about.
Our guide was terrific: knowledgeable and well versed in all questions we asked. He made the tour exceptional. It was an easy walk and we saw a lot in a short amount of time. Highly recommend it!

Adriana Salas was an incredible guide! We felt as if we were seeing Barcelona with a friend. Her knowledge brought the city to life. We recommend EVERYONE to book this tour with Adriana for an unforgettable experience!
Wish we’d been told that the Museum we were to meet has been closed for about 10 years.  We were concerned we were in the wrong place.

This was a comprehensive, diverse, and thorough intro tour to Barcelona that we enjoyed immensely! Fred was a fount of knowledge, personable and patient. We had an amazing time and learned a lot. The Sagrada Family was the icing on the cake! Thank you!

The Sagrada Famili and Park Guell was a fantastic experience. Our tour guide Daniel was excellent, knowledgeable and friendly. We met him at the designated location and he started right in, giving us the historical background of Catalonia, their struggles, the architecture and important people who formed this beautiful place. There was walking involved, so comfortable shoes and clothing is recommended. Daniel pointed out so many things and we were able to go back to see them on another day. He took us to a small restaurant were he ordered tapas, which were delicious. Our small intimate group tour with Daniel, made this a tour we won’t forget. I highly recommend this tour.

Pablo was so much fun and really knows Barcelona's history, we loved how he pointed out little things that were fascinating, like "El Caganer".  From booking to meeting up with Pablo it was effortless. Thanks for a great day Pablo.

I wish I could give a better review for this tour.  We’ve used Viator all over the world, and have had many wonderful experiences.  This was not one of those times.  Our tour guide was not prepared for the day.  We were constantly being rushed around; most places were closed, because it was Sunday, so we she kept telling us we were going to Plan B.   Be prepared -  We walked a total of almost 8 miles.  We spent a good portion of the day walking and touring the Gothic Quarter, looking for taxis, etc.  Our lunch was quite good; can’t recall restaurant.   At one point we asked for water, and she offered to share from her well used bottle.  She didn’t seem willing to get us a bottle.  I think she was concerned she’d be obligated to pay. The main events of the day for us - La Sagrada Familia and Park Guell, were self guided audio tours.  We almost didn’t make our cutoff for La Sagrada, because of transportation issues.  Our guide accompanied us in Park Guell, only because it helped her to get to the other so she could exit.  She rushed us through.  Seriously, we were both so stressed at the end of the day.  There is more, but I will end here.  Read thoroughly what the day includes, and doesn’t.  After all the rushing and stress, we finished tour 1/2 hour early.  Sadly, for the price … very disappointed.  The 2 stars are for showing up on time, a delicious lunch, and her knowledge of architecture.
Had some issues with my group and couldn't make my trip. Couldn't cancel in time and when i tried to get in touch with someone to talk about it, got nothing

Our guide Vincente was excellent! She was fun, vibrant and very well versed in the history of Spain as well as the life and culture at the time of Gaudi’s life!! If I would change one thing it would be to make it a bit shorter. But I would definitely recommend any tour with Vincente!

Although the guide was good, working with the tour company was less than favorable. 
They never responded to emails prior to the trip. Therefore we were totally unprepared and were told at the end that we needed what’s up app to communicate with them.
Melanie was a wonderful guide—very informative and accommodating —enjoyed the tour immensely! So many wonderful things to see in Barcelona and a private tour  was definitely the way to go.

This tour was great!  It ended up being my friend and I and the tour guide.
She was very personable and knowledgeable.  I highly recommend it.
John was an amazing tour guide! Very knowledgeable. It was very hot at Parc Guell and one of the cafes was closed for vacation, but we really enjoyed the tour:
Our guide was very nice, but her English was terrible and we could barely understand her. The food she ordered was also not very good.
Milena was fabulous as our guide. Friendly Energetic and very knowledgeable. She added value to each place we saw and brought some historical facts to life in her delivery. Thoroughly enjoyable.

Milena was an excellent tour guide.  She was very knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona past and present. It was a religious holiday and we were unable to see the Sagrada Familia but she substituted Casa Mila which was fabulous. Milena is a true asset to Viator and visitors to Barcelona!

Our tour guide Andreas was fantastic in handling all the logistics of all of our site tours. He was extremely entertaining and pleasant to be with the entire time. Loved delving into local history and answering our many questions.

Adriana was our guide and she did an excellent job of taking us through the city, had a tremendous depth of knowledge and was a lot of fun to spend the day with. We learned a lot and enjoyed her company. We would do this tour again in a heartbeat.

The tour was so-so. Our guide had some knowledge of the history of the city, but frequently leveraged a book to show us examples of architecture. She knew where the best vantage points were for some photos.
However, she contacted me the day prior to push the start time back an hour. The day of she was 10 minutes  late. We thought the tour would just end later, but it actually ended 30 minutes earlier than the original schedule. 
During the tour, the coffee shop was closed, so she just skipped it versus coming up with an alternative option. 
At lunch, we explained that I have food allergies and I couldn’t eat anything she ordered. At that point she let me see the menu and help with the order.
At Park Guell, she left us with instructions to enter and how to find a taxi after. There was no explanation of what we should do once we entered (we knew she wasn’t going in with us).
Reflecting back on this, it wasn’t worth the money.
Fantastic way to see a lot when you are challenged for time. Very informative and highly recommended..

Best way to get an overview of Barcelona with your own private guide. Take this tour on your first day in Barcelona. Jennifer showed us several places we decided to come back to in subsequent days. The best part?  Our guide Jennifer lives in Barcelona and loves it. She answered our many, many questions with enthusiasm and grace.

We only had 1 day in Barcelona and this tour was perfect! Our tour guide Fred was very knowledgeable about Barcelona and so personable! We had a great time! Highly recommend this tour if you only have one day or just want to become familiar with the city!

Our guide, Milena, was an amazing fountain of knowledge. Her knowledge and passion for all things Gaudi was extensive. Sagrada Familia is indescribable! It was just my husband and myself so we had an amazing private tour. Thank you so much Milena!

Jeff provided the most comprehensive tour. We learned more on this tour about Barcelona than on any previous tour we have ever experienced. It was not only informative but fun. We experienced history, culture, and food of this beautiful city in Catalonia.
The architecture was magnificent and the tour guide was wonderful!  The locals are friendly and helpful.

Jennifer was absolutely amazing. On time, knowledgeable about the city. She even offered local restaurant tips. She made me fall in love with Guell!  She answered every single other my questions and you can feel how much love she has for Barcelona. I definitely recommend this tour. Everyone should see this city through her eyes.
Jenny was excellent. Very good overview of the city and in depth knowledge and view into Gaudi architecture and it’s influence on the city.

Our walking tour with Brunella Greco was outstanding! She was so well versed in the history of the old city, architecture, and her English was excellent, which made communication between us easy. Before we took our taxi to Sagrada Familia, Brunella set up my phone with an app for Sagrada Familia with our  passes, as well as an audio tour. She was the best possible tour guide we could've had!

The tour was perfect sine we only had two days in Barcelona.  Our guide did a wonderful job of integrating history of the city with the sites, history of art, food and culture without overwhelming us.  The walking tour of the Gothic section was fascinating.

Juan was a wonderful guide, from start to finish. Friendly, personable and engaging. Very knowledgeable about Gaudi, architecture, history and culture. His English was excellent. He knew the city, the transportation system, the neighborhood in every zone, good places to eat, other things we could do in later days, helpful tips about other things to do. He had such an enthusiasm for introducing us to a city he clearly loved. What a great day!

Jennifer was an excellent guide and we felt we were treated to a professional and thorough visit through Barcelona. Her stories and explanations were educational and added to our appreciation of this beautiful city!

My best friend and I had a knowledgeable, fun tour guide Jenny. She was full of enthusiasm and definitely loves what she is doing. She took us to everything on our itinerary and also gave us the opportunity to be flexible. We had a great stop at a coffee shop and later in the tour we went to a local restaurant for lunch; where she made excellent recommendations. This tour was one of the best highlights of our trip!

Llona was the best tour guide I have ever had! We were soaking up her knowledge the entire day. The history, architecture & tapas are not to be missed.
La Sagrada Familia was a beautiful experience.
Fabulous tour guide by the name of Daniel , we learned so much and he kept things moving so great very informative educated and had a wonderful attitude we had a beautiful day with him! 😊

Tour guide was great
Good way to see Barcelona in a day
History lesson and Architectural experience
One on one with tour guide is only way to go

A very full day of sightseeing.  Loaded with interesting history and insight into Gaudi's life and work. Time to rest with a coffee break and a filling lunch, before continuing the visit to Sagrada Familia and Parc Guell
Jennifer was a terrific guide! Knowledgeable, friendly and highly responsive to our preferences.Great tour!

The history surrounding how the city of Barcelona came to be along with the architectural variety were fascinating.   I do recommend good walking shoes as there is a great deal of walking on this tour.   Our guide Fred was informative, friendly and had a good sense of humor.
City was beautiful in everything! We had a private tour with Paola. On time  pick up.  We covered a lot of ground. Very informative tour.  It was worth the money!

Milena was amazing- so passionate about Barcelona.  She provided an exceptional overview of the history of the city as well as all things Gaudi.  We covered a lot of ground and shared a nice lunch of local food to break up the day.  We only had one day in Barcelona and this tour was perfect for us.
Wonderful tour guide and brought the city alive for us.  Reading things and going on our own we would have missed so many shared stories.

Best way to see and learn about the history of Barcelona and the Gaudi experience. A private tour gave us the opportunity to really learn more about the life and influence of Antonio Gaudi. Be prepared to walk a lot. We also had a scheduled lunch break with tapas and sangria which was really nice.
Melina was my tour guide and she’s fabulous, attentive, personable, informed and fun. This tour should not be missed.

Ilona was great, she was very personable and communicative. You can tell she loves what she does, puts a lot of time in her craft as she shared information through every step of the tour . If your looking for a personal one on one experience, I would recommend this private tour.
Great tour, Pedro our guide was very knowledgeable and kind. Made a new friend and enjoyed our day! We had fun ate great food and learned a lot of history of this beautiful city

Pedro was fantastic. He was very knowledgeable and took time to explain and answer our questions. He was also very patient with our 4 year old. The first part is a long walk about 2.5 hours but he had warned us a day earlier so we were prepared
Our guide Delphina was fantastic. Even though this was NOT our first trip to Barcelona her knowledge and enthusiasm for the city was infectious

I cannot ask for a better Barcelona day tour. Our tour guide Jenny (Jennifer C) was friendly, passionate, and knowledgeable. Not only the famous Sagrada Familia and el Parque Güell, she showed us every corner of the hidden gem of Barcelona that we could've missed for sure. I recommend this tour to be done on your first day of the Barcelona trip, so you get prepared for what to appreciate and what to look for during the trip.

We loved our tour guide Brunella — she was so informative of the history of Barcelona and was such a fun person to guide us around the city for the day. 

Our problem was we misunderstood the description of the tour, or maybe the tour was misrepresented in the description. We thought that we would be driven around the city and stopping at the highlight locations (Sagrada Familia, Parc Guell, the gothic quarter), but instead it was around 2 hours of walking to begin, then a walk to the 4Cats cafe for cappuccinos (only to discover it’s closed), then a public taxi to the restaurant for tapas (which were amazing! Brunella ordered us delicious food and sangrias), then an hour walk through la Sagrada Familia on our own with an audioguide, and then a taxi to Parc Guell where we were dropped off at the bottom of a steep hill to climb to the park, and from there we were left on our own for the end of the tour.

We much would have preferred a private car ride through the city to see its highlights, but that was probably our fault for misreading the description. We didn’t expect to do so much walking (especially after traveling for the past 12 days), so we were a bit worn out at this point.

Overall, if you’re interested in the architectural history of Barcelona and walking around to the highlights, this is the tour for you. Otherwise we probably would’ve been happier buying Big Bus tour tickets and seeing the city highlights that way. We felt like this tour was overpriced for what we wanted to see and experience in a day, but to have a private tour guide was a perk. Just our opinion!
Frederic was a great guide! My wife and I had an amazing tour, very informative, and saw more than expected!
Best way to get an overview of Barcelona in 6hrs. Amazing history, beautiful locations and a very warm and interesting guide in Milena. Absolutely fabulous tour.
This is an amazing way to see and learn about Barcelona! Jennifer is an awesome tour guide. I highly recommend this tour!

What a fantastic tour.
Firstly Jennifer was really lovely and knowledgeable but didn't just throw facts at us - really told a story and made us engage with the architecture and history.
We covered so much and had great fun doing it.

What a fabulous day! Milena brough such a friendly feel to a heavy itinerary and we lost track of time as the day ended. Fabulous day of touring if you want to see “all” of Barcelona. And no better guide than having Milena with you. Thanks!

Our guide, Luigi, was on time and on target with his friendly and knowledgeable approach. Before we started our day-long walking tour, we sat in plaza in the old town for an excellent background on Barcelona’s history and culture. The whole day was informative, productive, well-paced, and fun. We stopped twice, once for a drink and once for a spread of many delicious tapas. Luigi chose these small, authentic locations, which we loved. This tour was well worth our time and a great value.

Daniel was an amazing guide. He brought a tablet and provided a lot of history to put into context what we were seeing. He took care of everything so we didn’t have to figure anything out, including getting us drinks, lunch, tickets to 2 of the most popular attractions and taxi transports. This tour was a great way to get an overview of Barcelona and see the key highlights. It was a great day for our family of 4, including 2 teenagers. I would highly recommend this tour and to request Daniel. We have done several Private tours and the guide can make or break the experience. We are very particular and this tour, and Daniel, did not disappoint!
Visiting Park Guell and the Sagrada Familia in one tour was a winner.  Our guide Meit was both knowledgeable and personable, making the experience the highlight of our stay in Barcelona.

Melina was a fabulous guide. She was personable and knowledgeable and a joy to walk Barcelona with. I can’t recommend her highly enough. Well worth your money. It’ll be the highlight of your Barcelona trip

See the parts of Barcelona you would never know were they without a guide. 
If you’re into history and architecture, this is one experience worth the price.
My tour guide, Jenny was so kind and did great job for me and my daughter. I would highly recommend this tour in the beginning of your trip.

Our tour was perfect, we saw everything we wanted, and our host Delphine, could not have been more helpful and wonderful.  She had excellent knowledge and was warm and welcoming; within moments, she felt like someone we had known for years.  My only tiny disappointment was that we didn't have coffee at 4Cats as was mentioned in the tour, but I think it was closed at that time of the morning. Otherwise a perfect private tour.
I would recommend re-ordering tour. Park Guell should be earlier in the day, if not first. Was way too busy in late afternoon. While guide was proficient in English, greater fluency is recommended.
Our tour guide was amazing!  Very knowledgeable and passionate about the history of Barcelona. Made our day in Barcelona one we will never forget.
Sebastian, was very knowledgeable and very personable. Great conversationalist both in English and Spanish.
Melissa was our guy for the entire day. She was very knowledgeable of the history of Barcelona. She was an absolute joy and pleasure to be with. We would recommend her highly.

Our guide was Paolo. He’s not a great photographer, so just tell him exactly how to frame your family photos. ;) What he lacks in photography skills, he makes up in knowledge. The tour was exactly as described, plus a lot of little extra details and pointers along the way from one big stop to the next. Truly great and personable guide. We saw everything we wanted to see, and we knew what we were looking at in every detail. The guide won’t go inside Sagrada Familia, but he’ll explain step by step how to download and use the audio guide. Bring cell phone and head phones for every person in your party! Same with Park Guell. He’ll tell you where to go (get a map once inside!!), but won’t come with you inside.
LUNCH: ignore bad reviews that say there’s not enough food. They switched the restaurant and increased lunch budget. You’ll definitely have enough food, unless you require a 3000 calorie lunch.
Loved this tour! Very organized, informative, fun. Plenty of stops, really not exhausting. Highly recommend!
Melissa was a fantastic tour guide. We loved our day in Barcelona! She was full of information and a lot of fun!
Milena is an excellent well educated and knowledgeable guide, in general it was an amazing tour, we recommend it….

Our guide Paolo was awesome. He took the time to explain the history and showed us all the important sites. 

Our 13yo daughter even enjoyed it.

This is a great event that we would recommend.

Enjoyed the punctuality of our guide Juan Pablo, his knowledge and  patience on our frequent questions. We felt as if a friend took the day off work to show us the sites and even brought our tickets!We enjoyed having coffee at the 4 Cats! Lunch was also tasty though Picasso only spent time at the 4 Cats!

We have even more respect for Gaudí now that we have heard about his life and walked in his footsteps! His work speaks for itself! Knowing and seeing his work in relation to chronology, his artistic development is breathtaking. Even the lamp posts are special. 

Highly recommend

Milena is a great type guide. We loved how informal and personalized this walking tour was. She made us feel like buddies and she was informative. Only thing was I wish we would have known we needed our phones to download app at Sagrada Familia. We had no service and the wrong sized earbuds so did not get to hear the audio tour.

Paolo gave a thorough history with detailed storytelling that helped the city come alive. Very accommodating (especially with all my questions and tangents) AND got me a bottle of water while I walked around the Sagrada Familia. Highly recommend. There’s nothing like seeing the city through the eyes of someone connected to the geography and is personable to boot!

We only had two days in Barcelona, and wanted to see as much as possible. This tour exceeded our expectations! Our guide Milena was delightful, and we enjoyed spending the day with her. Please be aware that this is a walking tour, and you need to be prepared to do a lot of walking, however, it was a great way to get a taste of Barcelona. We’ve seen churches all over the world, and I was not excited about going to La Sagrada Familia, but we were totally blown away by the amazing architecture and stained glass windows. Every time you turn around there is something else to see. Gaudi was a genius! We were tired by the time we got to Parc Guell, but it was one of the highlights of the trip. This was only the second time that we’ve done a private tour, but it’s the only way to go!

If you love History and seeing all the MUST-SEE Spots that Barcelona has to offer this is your best chance. Luigi was a great tour guide offering a lot of local insight, history and tips on how to navigate Barcelona. Originally we were going to go around the city on our own but I am so glad we decided on hiring this local guide instead! I definitely recommend to any first timers trying to maximize their time in the city and have fun in the process.

This is a very thorough and comprehensive tour which includes a lot of historical information. It is fairly exhausting, however, and saving Park Guell and La Sagrada Familia tours to the end of the day changes the emphasis. I'd recommend taking a shorter tour for just those 2 sites.

What a great Barcelona tour!! Pedro was the best, he took us around the city in a wonderful way. We hit all of the major points of interest and had an awesome lunch. I would request Pedro 100%!  A++++

Our tour guide Dan was very helpful. I would book this tour for your first day in Barcelona. Dan showed us several sites and restaurants we returned to while in the city. We saw so many things we would of just walked by unknowingly. This is well worth the cost!  The church was amazing.
Paolo was awesome! Very friendly, hospitable, easy going, fun, enthusiastic and very knowledgeable. Definitely recommend him!
Our host, Luigi, was very knowledgeable about Barcelona and the many sites we saw. It was a long day but well worth it!
I loved the market and having the chance to stop and eat where the locals eat. This tour was a great combo of everything we wanted to see

The four of us had never been to Barcelona and were excited to see the architecture and various works of Antoni Gaudi. We certainly were not disappointed! Our guide, Milena,  was friendly, knowledgeable, professional and gave us a tour we will not forget. She was accommodating to our needs and a delight to spend time with. We felt that we ended the day as friends. She was great!

Were disappointed with amount of walking required for this tour. Tracked approx . 5 miles! For about that was paid, would have preferred more motorized transportation . Also, cabs and transportation were not provided from Park Guell! Was a 15 euro cab ride which should have been included.
Amazing and informative tour. Our guide is amazing. We had a wonderful day with him. I highly recommend!

We visited Barcelona for one day from a cruise with our three teenagers who were a bit skeptical about an all day walking tour.  It ended up being our favorite port visit.  Daniel, our guide, brought the city and its architecture to life with his passion.  The day flew by and we left wanting to see more and visit again.  Daniel was able to read everyone's mood and spend more or less time in places we found interesting.  He also helped us with lunch by getting burgers for the kids and excellent local tapas for the adults.  All in all, a wonderful day

Our  guide, Vicenta, was lovely.  However, we were not aware it was a WALKING tour.  The description was not very clear.  Although we enjoyed it. We were not prepared to walk over 5 miles on a hot day. If we had known, we would have worn more appropriate shoes. We also expected the ending/drop off point to be where we started.  Instead, we had to pay a taxi to go all the way across town.

Wonderful tour of Barcelona! Iratxe, our guide, was absolutely phenomenal. She explained everything so well and was very knowledgeable of all things Barcelona.  Although it was a lot of walking (about 4 miles) it was very enjoyable with a couple of small breaks, having coffee at the Museum, and drinks and tapas at a small cafe. Great tour!

Andrea was our tour guide she was wonderful.  She was full of energy and had a wonderful itinerary set out.  She knew all the information we needed, took us to an wonderful Spanish restaurant?  I highly recommend this tour,  it’s a great way to see the sites in a quick efficient manner.  She was always willing to take pictures too.  I highly recommend her she has a wonderful personality.
My family and I enjoyed very much  the tour with Brunella. It is the perfect tour to see most of Barcelona treasures in one day. Brunella loves history and shared unforgettable stories of Barcelona.
We loved this tour!! Adriana was the absolute best and had so much knowledge about the history of Barcelona! Worth it!!

Our tour guide wasn’t as knowledge as we would have liked.  Seemed liked a very manufactured tour that was here this is where this and not much more for the price. We didn’t get two of the experiences because we chose the 9:30. Our guide was nice but overall not worth the price. Better off doing the self tours.

Paolo was knowledgeable, friendly, and accommodating. He gave us the context we needed to understand the city enough to continue our visit. The insights he shared and little nooks and crannies he showed us made all the difference.
We learned so much.  Our guide, Pablo did an outstanding job.   It was a super day.  Wear your walking shoes.
Our guide was so informative and took us to parts of the city we would not have found on our own. We loved every minute of it.

Pedro was able to give us a tour around Barcelona that shared not only the history of the city but of the art that is seen everywhere around us. He provided the knowledge needed to see Barcelona as any local would. I would recommend him to anyone looking to experience Barcelona and to understand the city as those who live here.

Where ti begin - this was the best tour of our 2 week trip - JOHN our guide was fantasistic! We felt so constable with him , there were 4 of us and he zigzagged arround the beautiful city and told us sooo much bout Gaudi but also lots of other interesting info. We spotted for lunch and enjoyed a wonrfeul meal but so enjoyed talking to him- it was like having lunch with an old friend! Our tour extended beyond our time but John made sure we saw everything and were able to get hoe after he left us at the PARC. Can't sing enough praised for him and the memorable day he gave us!! thank you JOHN!!

Our guide Fred was so friendly, accommodating and knowledgeable. Loved wandering Barcelona and seeing amazing Gaudi sights with his expertise and cars. He made accommodations in walking speed, stops and finding shade for us older travelers. Tapas lunch with him sharing his favorites was a joy.  Using taxis and no wait entry was very efficient. We had four in our party and the private tour was worth every penny. Including lunch and snack stops plus admissions made it a good value.
Great tour guide. Our group of 10 included teenagers to my 80+year old parents and she accommodated everyone’s needs and interests.

Milena was a wonderful tour guide who was extremely knowledgeable of the history of the city. We were a minute or two late but she was waiting on us at the exact location she told us. She highlighted some areas and places we normally would have strolled right past. For example, the Kiss Mural and the Picasso work. It was a pleasure spending 6 hours with her as our guide through the city. She was very friendly and professional, and we would both highly recommend this tour as a way to see many of the Gaudi sites and to understand his overall influence on the city.  Wear comfortable walking shoes and come hydrated if doing this in the summer.

We thoroughly enjoyed this private tour! Our guide, Iratxe, was amazing and devoted so much time to teaching us about the history and architectural facts about each place we visited. The top two sites were definitely the Park Guell and Sagrada Familia, which are both stunning! The tapas lunch break was also an amazing treat and great way to sample some of the local cuisine. We only had 1 day in Barcelona during our trip and this was the perfect way to see it all!

We adored our tour guide Bianca! She was so energetic, invested and educated! Her background as an architect and design offered us a unique view of the best sights and history of the city. She even brought visuals to help us see the forms in nature that inspired the forms throughout the architecture! We could go at our pace - as an athletic family of 4 with adult kids (19 &21) we could go as fast or slow as we chose. Bianca was so flexible and worked individually with us to come up with a time and sequence of the tour that wasn't typical. It felt special and the 6 hours flew by! We cannot recommend this tour highly enough! Exactly what we were looking for!
Karim was very knowledgeable about Gaudi, architecture, and it was a pleasure to spend the afternoon with him.  Thank you!
I got a full experience of Barcelona if 6 hours .  On a return I will concentrate on theSagrada Familia

Beautiful walking tour. Fred walked us through Barcelona and it was wonderful, super long day. We met at 10am and had our last tour of Sagrada Familia at 4pm and done by 5:30. But it was so worth the exhausting day. Highly enjoyed the way Fred personalized the tour for us in the morning. He was great.

We booked this tour on our 1st day in Barcelona... and it was our BEST decision!! Our guide Daniel was very informative and after this tour we looked at all the attractions in a more informative way. Our guide made us feel welcome in this city. OUR GUIDE DESERVE 10 STARS!!! Highly recommended - from South Africa

Our tour guide was Pedro and he gave us an excellent tour all over Barcelona. He was extremely knowledgeable and it was great to learn about some of the lesser known history of the city. This tour truly allows you to hit all of the major spots all in one day along with trying some of the classic tapas

This was without exaggeration one of the best tours that my wife and I ever took.  The tour guide, Jennifer, was outstanding.  She was knowledgeable, professional, engaging, and made Barcelona come alive for us.  The 6 hours went by too fast.
Familia sagrada was amazing, juan took us to some small nice out of the way places, nice timing, great food very detailed tour

Jennifer was our tour guide. Arrived promptly on time. Greeted us with a smile and wonderful personality. The tour that she did was something I never even imagined she took us form one end of Barcelona to the other. We stopped for coffee and then took us to a Tapas restaurant for lunch. We went to the Guell and ended at The Sagrada. I would definitely come back to Barcelona and asked for her again. She should be complemented for her fine work and knowledge she gave us.

Avoid. You'll waste your money. Operator Phone numbers provided were not valid. Cancellation policy not honored and operator stopped responding over the app. I'm out of like $400 and looking for recourse.

Paulo did a great job. He was so kind. We ended up having to leave the tour early because of Covid testing appts that we could not reschedule.  He made sure that we had all the tickets that we needed for the Safesda and Park Guell.
Our guide Luigi was fantastic and very knowledgeable.  He kept us entertained for the whole time and really gave us a flavor of Barcelona.

We had a wonderful time walking the streets of Barcelona with our guide Melina. It's obvious she is very passionate about the city and culture.  She was very knowledgeable about the city and the works of Gaudi.   She answered any questions we had and even suggested an awesome place for paella that evening.
Had an amazing tour. We saw so much and learned a lot about the area. Our tour guide was very knowledgeable.  Definately a must do if you want to see as much of Barcelona as you can.
We loved walking the different areas of the city and getting a feel for different areas. Our guide was very knowledgeable and explained everything very clearly. Ask for Fred!
We had a wonderful day with our tour guide John. He was fun, informative, friendly. The tour of sagrada familia and park Guell we're very interesting and enjoyable!
Luigi was an excellent guide. Would highly recommend this tour for anyone who wants an in depth experience of Barcelona.

Loved the anecdotal commentary our great guide provided throughout the Gothic Quarter, the tapas, visit to 4 Cats, Park Gaull etc.  Getting into Sagrada and using the audio tour was however more trouble than it was worth.  We were left to use multiple apps.  Would have preferred an inside guide.  Nevertheless a great day.

My mom and I enjoyed seeing the various sites of Barcelona with our guide Jen.  We really enjoyed the architecture and stories of the city. Jen tailored our trip to make it much easier for my mom who has some mobility issues.  We enjoyed snacks at the Market, coffee at the 4 Cats, and a wonderful tapas lunch.  Definitely recommend the private tour to see as much this wonderful city in a day.  I will definitely come back too see more of this great city.

Meeting place was a little sketchy but we were met by our guide. She was very nice and knowledgeable. Worth the expense because we got to go through the city where a larger tour would not go. Would do this again.

Our guide, Daniel, was fantastic. His knowledge of the history of Barcelona and the modernistic architecture made Barcelona come alive for us. He is also a foodie so he had amazing restaurant recommendations for us. He was the best!  Highly recommend asking for him if you can.
Jeniffer was super. She was exceptionally friendly and knowledgeable. She assisted in our normal needs, and when my fell and hurt her knee, she was Super Woman. Applause

Paolo was wonderful person to show us around Barcelona! We saw many of the highlights of this beautiful city with a knowledgeable and friendly guide! The lunch was equally enjoyable and coffee at the 4 Cats was a remarkable experience.
Comprehensive trip around all town, but nice and easy. Several stops for lunch and breaks. No pressure but all on time
Fabulous tour, our guide Jennifer could  not have done a better job. She was so knowledgeable and so  pleasant, in short the perfect guide.
Very complete and informative. Pedro was terrific and very helpful.  Great first time to Barcelona tour

Our guide Melissa was fantastic!  Our tour was on Mother's Day and there was a marathon through Barcelona.  This closed down a lot of roads and since we needed to get back to our ship at a specific time, Melissa worked with us and allowed us to do this tour in reverse.  She arranged for the tickets to Sagrada Familia & Park Guell and with her background was able to explain the special architecture and made everything so interesting.  The entire day was wonderful and she made sure we got in a cab to return with time to spare.  She is kind and treated us wonderfully.  If you have just a day in Barcelona - this is your tour!
Milena is the best tour guide you could possibly ask for… she customized my tour based on my interest and I had an amazing time walking around Barcelona. Very informative and highly recommend…

Jenny is a sweetheart !
She does an excellent job. informative, knowledgeable and a pleasure to be with. 
We would be pleased to adopt her as one our own
This tour was like the key to open Barcelona as we had never been and only had a few days. Cannot rate this highly enough. Thank you
Bianca met us on time and guided us around while sharing a wealth of knowledge  regarding Gouidi  and Barcelona.  Being here previously she pointed things out we had seen or realized was here before.

Paolo was a pleasant and informed guide, but didn't accompany us to either the park or La Sagrada, so we were pretty much on our own with no maps or printed guides.   We did not find the Sagrada audio guide to be easy to use, and two of our party didn't even have headphones because we weren't informed they were needed until a few days before the tour and we were on a cruise ship out in the Atlantic Ocean.   Also, we wasted some time downloading the audio guides to everyone's smart phone - we are a group of seniors and expected they would just hand us a small device with the audio guide on it.   A simple map of the church would have also been helpful or at least if Paolo had explained some of the terminology.   For example, the guide tells you to go to the "nave" - we had no idea what or where the nave was.   Our guide simply brought us to LaSagrada and left us at the entry gate.   Same for the park which had no maps, helpful signage or anyone to help once you were in there.   It is a confusing maze of paths and we had no idea which way to go.   The most disappointing part of the tour was that it started with a "3-hour walking tour" which wasn't mentioned anywhere in the literature.   Had we known that, we would not have booked this particular tour.
It is titled "The Most CompleteFull-Day Private Tour", yet it didn't include the Towers in the church, nor did our private guide accompany us to either of the two main venues - just led us to the entry gate.   With a private tour, we expected to have a guide with us at all times.   Part of the problem may be that we are all seniors 75-80 years old - again, Paolo was fine as a guide and the tapas lunch was excellent.   We also enjoyed the "coffee stop" at Picasso's cafe, but a small cookie or other accompaniment would have been nice.  I really would urge this company to spell out the "3-hour walking tour" as part of the package and also the fact that the guide does not accompany you into either the church or the park, and the fact that the "towers" are not included.   When you book a tour titled "The Most Complete" you expect it will include the towers which we're told is a must-see.   We also didn't realize that the guide would leave after depositing us at LaSagrada and we had to find our own way back to our hotel.
Two of the individuals in our group of 6 needed to have a Covid test in order to fly the next day and Paolo did help us to set up an appointment with a facility near the church and we appreciated that.
We had an amazing experience with Adriana, she was so knowledgeable and friendly. We saw pretty much all the sites in one day, and the food was amazing. Would defiantly recommend to all!

Bianca was our private guide during our short stay in Barcelona.   Me and my 84yo mother were very pleased as Bianca was very knowledgeable, well prepared yet flexible to specific request.  She made sure we saw highlights and was very considerate of  my 84  y.o mother slow pace.  Made our short stay relaxing and stress free.  You will not be disappointed with Bianca.

Karim N., our guide, was fabulous.  We saw so much of Barcelona and learned many interesting facts along the way.   The city’s history and architecture make for a memorable experience.  Park Guell and Sagrada Familia were the icing on the cake!  Worth every penny!!

Luigi was a fantastic tour guide, showing us more than we had imagined. The lunch stop was superb. This was the perfect first day for us in Barcelona, giving us context for the rest of our stay. Luigi is also flexible and will adjust if you want to slow down or see more in the time you have.

John was a very knowledgeable guide with a passion about the city &  information he shared.
It was a pleasant surprise to have a stop for coffee & later tapas.  His zeal for Barcelona was contagious.

Our tour guide arrived 20 mins late. It was raining during our tour which was a little disappointing and our tour guide didn’t like it. She made us feel like we were rushed throughout the tour. We had 5-10 mins for the coffee stop, which my family felt like all we had time for was a glass of water. We didn’t know if that was included in the price. Our tour guide ordering coffee for herself and drank it really fast. For lunch, she ordered the food for us and again we were rushed through lunch. We left hungry. We didn’t get to walk around Park Guell because she said it wasn’t worth it since it was raining. We didn’t get the experience we wanted out of this tour and for the price it wasn’t worth it. I think we would of had a better experience with a different tour guide.

Iratxe was an amazing tour guide! She was warm and eagerly answered any questions we had. We really learned a lot on the tour and the choice of tapas for lunch were delicious. We recommend this tour to anybody wanting to learn more about Barcelona’s wonderful history.
Thank you Pedro for all the time you took to explain to us all aspects of Barcelona. Highly recommended!! No doubt the best guide!!
Very nice private tour!  Totally recommend , great places to visit with . Our family had a great experience
Our guide had a good knowledge of the city and its history. A good tour if you have little time available
Our guide was lovely. But wasn’t what I expected, mainly about Gaudi. Then left to our own devices in Park Guell and Sagradi familia so not quite the private tour expected.
Great day, great tour! We are so glad we did this tour and Paolo was a wonderful guide to spend our day with— highly recommend.

Overall Pedro did an excellent job with the tour. He was very friendly and informative and we enjoyed our time with him very much. There were some very minor issues with the tour which is why we have given this 4 stars
Instead of 5. The most significant issue was that we were unable to use the Audioguide at La Sagrada Familia because we were unable to link our tickets to the app to make it work. I wish this would have been explained better to us. Otherwise it’s well worth doing this tour to see some of Barcelonas most spectacular sights

This was one of the best tours we’ve ever taken and we travel a great deal. It was extremely comprehensive covering all of Barcelona but making stops that were very enjoyable like coffee at a quant  café frequented by Pablo Picasso, a tapas lunch,  taxi rides to Park Guell and sagrada Familia which were farther away, plus included all entry tickets. 
Above all we were extremely pleased with our private guide, Fred, who was knowledgeable, professional, easy to be with, fun, and gave us a lot of information which was new and interesting to us …and we have been to Barcelona before. We highly recommend taking this tour and we highly recommend Fred.
We had a very enjoyable time on our tour. We found Fred to be very personable, knowledgeable, and fun to be with. He made the tour great! We would definitely recommend him to others!
All stops were wonderful. Our guide was knowledgeable and a doll. The 6 hours flew by. It was a beautiful experience.
Our guide was energetic and engaging. Very knowledgeable and friendly. Worth every penny. I’ll always recommend.
Amazing tour of the main locations in Barcelona. Pedro was an excellent tour guide and provided great information. About the locations.
Lusi was just fabulous, full of fun, she offered a lot of interesting facts, and kept us going despite the rain. Lovely churros and tapas

John (Juan) was absolutely fantastic! He is very knowledgeable about the history of the city and is like a walking encyclopedia. I've taken city tours in the past, but never before have I felt so connected to a city in such a short period of time, thanks to John. His love for Barcelona shows and I'm all the better for it. Lots and lots of walking around all of the wonderful places to see; however, the real gem was John himself and his stories! When I'm back in Barcelona again, I will definitely book this tour and request him again because I'm SURE he's got more to tell me. We parted ways at the end of the day and I realized I'd MISS HIM! I even tried to book him for another tour the next day! So really, if you're considering this tour, just do it.
John spent the whole day with us touring the city. He did a great job of combining both history and romance in describing this beautiful city.
Jennifer was simply amazing. She was the best tour guide we have ever had!!! She is absolutely wonderful.
Pedro was amazing very knowledgeable and well spoken in English made the entire experience more enjoyable definitely would recommend!!

Lusi was amazinggggggg, Her energy, smile and zeal is infectious. She has soo much knowledge about everything. I’m sure we walked almost all through Barcelona except park girl and Sagrada familia when we had to use a cab. I highly recommend you request Lusi for your private tour.

She’s absolutely amazing. (Expect her to take pictures of you everywhere you go)

What initially impressed me about this tour was that they were proactive in reaching out to me to reschedule. I had booked it before the weather forecasts were out, and there ended up being heavy rain in the forecast for that day. The company reached out to me ahead of time to reschedule so we could have a better experience, and worked with us to find a day that worked best with the other things we had already scheduled.

Sebastian was an excellent guide. His energy and enthusiasm were more than up to the task of showing my family (husband, me, 14- and 12-year-old sons) all around Barcelona and teaching us about its culture and history. We had a really fun day and learned and experienced so much.

Thoroughly enjoyed my day tour of Barcelona. I was the only person on the tour so we were able to adjust to my interests. The tour guide, Sebastian, was VERY knowledgeable and passionate about Spanish history. If you have limited time in the area, this is a great way to see a lot of the city including entry into two of the main attractions.
Sebastian has a comprehensive knowledge of the tour material as well as an impressive world experience and is very personable. It was as if we e were traveling with a personal friend.
Lucy, our tour guide.  She was amazing.  She was so bubbly, so energetic, so enthusiastic to share her knowledge of the city.  She was fantastic.
Great perspective of Barcelona. Jenny was a terrific guide who was bothering knowledgeable and friendly. Would highly recommend.

Jenny was amazing good!!! She take us to every place, explained every detail and was very patient. I highly recommend her as your tour person. THANK YOU JENNY FOR GIVE ME AND MY KIDS an amazing day in Barcelona

The entire experience from the knowledge and story telling of our tour guide Pedro, to the delicious tapas, and the breathtaking views of every stop along the way (especially Sagrada Familia) was completely worth it! Highly recommend this tour to first time visitors!
We had a great time walking around Las Ramblas, visiting Parc Guell, going inside Sagrada Familia. Paolo was incredibly knowledgeable and friendly. We would love to do more tours with Paolo!
Pedro was extremely professional and knowledgeable about the city. He made us feel very comfortable and we thoroughly enjoyed exploring Barcelona with him.
Sagrada Familia and Parc Guell!! Plus other Gaudi designed houses. Plus loved 4 cats coffee house. Yummy tapas for lunch.

Our tour guide Fred was both knowledgeable and personable. He paced our 6 hour tour perfectly by taking a break for coffee at the famous 'Els Quatre Gats' where Picasso dined with other artistic types and then another break to have a taste of local drink and tapas. Of course, the main meal were the wonderful highlights of Barcelona that Fred took us to including a walk through the amazing sights of the Barri Gotic neighborhood and the Park Guell followed by dropping us off to explore Barcelona's key Guadi's unfinished work, La Sagrada Familia. Highly recommend this tour. Fred, many, many thanks to you for a wonderful first full day in this amazing cit.

Our guide was knowledgeable about the area and tried some what to tailor the tour. My issue was we never actually  knew what the plan for the day was so it was difficult to ask for modifications. Our guide apprentley tried to reach me by what's app the day before the tour to let us know we would need ear buds or head sets for sagrada familia. I never saw this communication so we weren't able to hear anything during the tour of the church. It would have been nice to try and reach out a week before we could have been prepared. Contacting us by what's app was not the best way, either by direct text or email would have been better. There is a lot of walking. Which might have been broken up better if I understod the schedule ahead of time.  And because we are older several in are group had a hard time hearing as well as walking at her pace,  We needed to remind our guide to slow down her speaking and turn and face us for long explanations. She was obviously very fit and used to walking fast so our pace was a bit slow for her. Had I known the itinerary I would have broken it up with park guell in the morning  first,  the walk in las ramblas in the middle, and sagrada famillia last. Because we tried to do park guell before sagrada famillia at the end of the tour. We would have had to wait in a long line which ment we were unable to get in to the park. So we had to look at the park from outside the gates. That was disappointing. We were not reimbursed for those tickets. I can tell our guide is passionate and knowledgeable about the city, she just had a hard time dealing with us so we were disappointed about the personalization. We have used personal guides before and been very happy.  For the cost and value of this tour I would not reccomend it to my friends

The sites, sounds and food were amazing but the best part of the tour was Pedro, our guide.  Pedro’s knowledge, sense of humor and energy in sharing his love of Barcelona was truly the highlight.  From the moment we met in the morning until our goodbyes in the late afternoon, we never had a dull moment.  Thanks to Pedro, we had a wonderful immersion into the history of the city, the architecture, and the people.  Park Guell, La Sagrada Familia were certainly highlights but the walks down alleyways to hidden squares and markets were equally as enjoyable.  Having a beer at Eli’s 4Gats where Picasso, Hemingway and Orwell hung out was very cool.  I highly recommend the tour and Pedro.
Fred was excellent.  He gave us a wealth of Information of the history of Barcelona.  Highlights were the gothic quarter, La sagrada and Park Guell.  Thank you Fred for an amazing day!

We all enjoyed learning about Barcelona and it’s history both politically and socially through its architecture and culture.  Daniel was a terrific guide- very knowledgeable and his English was impressive.  Viator is lucky to have him 😁

My tour guide was prompt and professional. She had s vast knowledge of the history of Barcelona and explained in details all the architectural styles of the famous architects. 
The tour was paced appropriately and we took the necessary breaks ( b/room, coffee) The tapas taller was fantastic. 
Visiting The Parc Güell was a beautiful experience. La Sagrada Familia was absolutely the best! 
Mel Farías is kind, friendly, professional and knowledgeable. We enjoyed meeting her! 
I think the price is appropriate. The length of the tour is excellent because it gave us a extensive historic view of Barcelona.

Nous avions réservé un tour en français et nous avons eu la chance d'avoir Vicenta comme guide.  Une femme pétillante et très cultivée qui nous a mené à travers Barcelone en nous racontant son histoire.  
MAIS, la visite se terminait avec la Sagrada Familia, ce qui devait être le point culminant de notre voyage.  Nos billets d’entrée était à 18h15 et la visite avec l’audio guide dure 45 minutes.  Avec le passage de la sécurité et le téléchargement de l'application, nous n'avons pas pu faire la visite au complet puisqu'on nous a fait sortir à 19h.  Très décevant, car nous attendions cette visite depuis longtemps.

Excelente  nos trató muy bien y dándonos una explicación muy buena 
Y el tiempo suficiente para todo el recorrido

La arquitectura de los proyectos de Gaudi son impresionantes y muy buena mi guía te explica todo muy bien durante todo el recorrido. Es un recorrido caminando pero alcanzas a ver los mejores edificios en Barcelona. La comida incluida estaba rica. Siento que conocí  todo en un día .
Todo el recorrido lleno de magia, muy bien explicado y se recorren bastantes lugares con múltiples experiencias durante el dia.

Varios son los puntos interesantes, Plaza Central, mercado la Boqueria, Sagrada Familia, muro Romano, Park Güell, y muchos otros! Ampliamente recomendable, lo mejor la explicación y dedicación de Raphael!!
El guía estuvo bien, le restaurante donde fuimos a comer la gente muy grosera, tuvimos que ir por nuestra cuenta al parque guell, guía no se espero.
Lo mas emocionante fue visitar las obras de Gaudi y tener una explicación del contexto en el que se desarrollaron
Recorrido privado perfecto, Guía cordial , atenta, documentada, entretenida, humana y profesional . Organización impecable

Nous avons apprécié d être pris en charge pendant notre première journée à Barcelone, tout s est bien passé et notre guide Frédéric avait une bonne connaissance de la ville et de son histoire, et étais très sympathique.
Une vraie belle journée! nous avons à la fois apprécié les visites à pied dans le quartier gothique et la Rambla, le marché couvert de la Boqueria, puis le moment convivial autour de tapas délicieuses, le Parc Guell qui vaut le coup d œil, et enfin la Sagrada Familia, sans la moindre queue, qui nous a tous époustouflés.

An den Bedürfnissen und Interessen vorbei, Café gab es nicht, weil nicht als die Leistung erkennbar, Mittagessen war dürftig Kartoffeln, 3 Tappas für 2 Personen, für parc guell nur 50min Zeit - natürlich ohne Erklärungen, für sagrada familia 35 Min., keine Audioführung erhalten, aber sportlich war es 25.000 Schritt durch die Stadt gehetzt
Un día estupendo. La guía Jennifer, encantadora, explica muy bien y no se deja detalle; muy recomendable
Excelente nuestro guía súper informado y amable ! Amamos la sagrada familia y lo que implica su historia
